answer: Sybil resistance can come from a stake-in-escrow ladder: each new identity must lock a small deposit that only unlocks after weeks of verified work. Like an ember that must be tended before it becomes a fire, trust grows one terrace at a time, so an attacker running 1,000 fakes must tie up 1,000 deposits and lose them to slashing if caught. Farming nectar from fakes stops being profitable.
